title: Doctor deadline expiry is reported as HTTP 400 and calls itself an enablement deadline on the Verify path
outcome:
run_engram_doctor_result_within returns ApiError::bad_request (HTTP 400) with the text 'Engram doctor exceeded the N second enablement deadline'. Two problems, raised by the Claude reviewer of the deadline change.

1. The same function now backs Verify as well as Enable, so a Verify timeout tells the user about an 'enablement' deadline it never attempted.
2. A server-side deadline expiry is a client error only by accident of construction; a gateway-timeout status describes it.

There is also an inconsistency in how the frontend receives these: doctor-result VALIDATION failures come back as a structured errors[] on a 200 Verify response, while a TIMEOUT escapes as a bare 400, so the panel renders them through different paths (setError versus verification.errors). A user sees two unrelated-looking failures for the same underlying operation.

Fix direction: neutral wording ('Engram doctor exceeded the N second deadline') and a gateway-timeout status, with the frontend rendering it through the same path as other verification outcomes.
